about: System app slots (parking spots) and the app that fills each by default. Any app that `provides:` a slot can replace the default. null = the spot exists, no default app is published yet.

shell.name: Shell (Wizard UX)
shell.note: wizard-ux, its own app (uses agent-service). Oscar's Wizard App or hermes-frontend-3 can fill it instead.

agent-service.name: Agent Service
agent-service.note: wizard-agent-service, headless, separate from the shell so any shell can use it.
